title: Critical Token Guard Auth Bypass Fixed in Laravel 13.29 and 12.68
content:
A critical auth bypass in Laravel's token API guard let attackers log in as other users on MySQL and MariaDB. Update to 12.68.0 or 13.29.0.

The post Critical Token Guard Auth Bypass Fixed in Laravel 13.29 and 12.68 appeared first on Laravel News.
